# Vendored libraries (served locally so the app works offline)
- dagre 0.8.5 — MIT — https://github.com/dagrejs/dagre
- marked 12.0.2 — MIT — https://github.com/markedjs/marked
- DOMPurify 3.1.6 — Apache-2.0 / MPL-2.0 — https://github.com/cure53/DOMPurify
- highlight.js 11.9.0 (+ github / github-dark styles) — BSD-3-Clause — https://github.com/highlightjs/highlight.js
- @xterm/xterm 5.5.0, @xterm/addon-fit 0.10.0, @xterm/addon-web-links 0.11.0 — MIT — https://github.com/xtermjs/xterm.js
- PDF.js (pdfjs-dist) 6.5.438 — Apache-2.0 — https://github.com/mozilla/pdf.js — `pdfjs/`: the minified library and
  worker, the viewer component and its stylesheet, the images that stylesheet uses, `cmaps/`, `standard_fonts/` (their
  licences beside them) and the JavaScript image decoders from `wasm/` (the WebAssembly ones are left out: the page's
  content policy does not allow WebAssembly)
- KaTeX 0.19.1 — MIT — https://github.com/KaTeX/KaTeX — `katex/`: the minified script and stylesheet, and the woff2 fonts
